page.layout: Two columns of names, each entry a line, the left column headed by a "53" page number at the top centre. Years in the left margin belong to the left column, years in the right margin to the right column. Headings: "Cæso Arembergio. C." with "Meganus Gubernator" beneath it, "Caspar Roblef. Gubernator" and "Georgius Lalainius, Gubernator" set in larger type. Column 1 runs top to bottom, then column 2 runs top to bottom. No text below the columns.

main_text.head: Cæso Arembergio. C.
Caspar Roblef. Gubernator
Georgius Lalainius, Gubernator.
main_text.l: 1580 [?]Vvillem vbbena, quo in custodiam dato surrogatus.

page.notes: Page number "53" printed at the top; read as printed. Left-margin years 1563 to 1573 and right-margin years 1574 to 1583 are reproduced as printed. The right-margin year beside "Georgius Lalainius" reads 1579 on the scan, but the sequence suggests 1577; left as printed and marked [?]. The year beside "Vvillem vbbena" is faint and was read as 1580 [?]. The line "Iohan vviifferinck," in the 1573 entry and the line "Iohan Thedema," in the 1574 entry are placed by their position in the column. Names are copied as printed, including the printed spellings "vviiffrinck" and "Derck Roberts". Lines are placed one per row; some indented continuation lines may be grouped differently in the printed layout. Headings "Cæso Arembergio. C." and "Caspar Roblef. Gubernator" were set as level 2 divisions; "Georgius Lalainius, Gubernator." likewise. The "lidem." lines are copied as printed.
